Denial, disappearance, malformed/oversized name or incomplete enumeration makes the entire source error, with no partial list. Generic gmain is not a marker; renamed/hidden threads evade.

Fixed libc/libdl entry comparison: at most 32 distinct changed function names in fixed resolution order; empty only after all 32 comparisons succeed. Compare min(16, nonzero symbol size) bytes from immutable executable ELF code with actual RX non-writable mapped addresses via checked own-process reads. Maps limited to 4 MiB/8192-byte lines, library 32 MiB; native ARM/Thumb, AArch64, x86 and x86_64 only. Missing/duplicate/reserved/IFUNC symbols, malformed metadata, text relocations, unavailable resolution, denied/short/stale reads or incomplete coverage produce error with no value and no partial list; unsupported off Android or for an unimplemented build architecture. Raw differences can include authorized instrumentation; matching disk/memory, unlisted/renamed targets, other inline sites, hidden modules and hookable APIs remain limitations, not malware or clean-device verdicts.

Complete sorted unique lowercase SHA256 digests of current signer leaves for exactly one applicable v2/v3/v3.1 scheme; chain entries and rotation history are not concurrent signers. API31+, v3.1 from API33; at most ten v2 signers, one applicable v3/v3.1 signer. Untrusted file hashes, not signature or lineage verification.

History is separate; no signature/attestation proof.

Public SigningInfo.getSigningCertificateHistory digests in oldest-to-current order including current; singleton without rotation, unsupported for validated parallel signing and never treated as concurrent current signers. API31+ public enabled AccessibilityServiceInfo list through the explicitly retained Application Context, not a private fallback. Sorted unique records package/full.Class capabilities=uint32 flags=uint32 preserve complete capability/request masks and distinct mask variants. At most 128 raw entries before deduplication, 1024 ASCII bytes per raw/normalized component and 131072 complete record bytes. Non-null empty list is OK empty; absent Context/service, denied/JNI/null/malformed/changing-size/over-limit reads are error with no partial list. Flags do not prove active control; legitimate assistive services are context, not malware. Off Android/below API31 unsupported.

API31+ public enabled IME list through the explicitly retained Application Context. Sorted unique canonical components, at most 128 raw entries before deduplication, 1024 ASCII bytes per raw/normalized component and 131072 complete bytes. Non-null empty list is OK empty; absent Context/service, denied/JNI/null/malformed/changing-size/over-limit reads are error with no partial list. This is enabled-list fallback context on API31-33, never a current-IME assertion. Independent of the selected component result; legitimate third-party/assistive keyboards are not malware. Off Android/below API31 unsupported.

API34+ public getCurrentInputMethodInfo reports the selected IME for the process user through the explicitly retained Application Context, not proof of a visible keyboard or processing text. API31-33 unsupported without newer-method lookup; no enabled-list substitution. One canonical component string, at most 1024 raw/normalized ASCII bytes. A null selected IME, absent Context/service, denied/JNI/malformed/over-limit read is error with no value, never empty-clean. Independent of enabled-list failures. Off Android/below API31 unsupported.

API31+ public Settings.Secure.getString of enabled_notification_listeners via the explicitly retained Application Context, following the AndroidX-compatible colon-separated component pattern; no hidden-field lookup or invented manager API. Sorted unique canonical components: at most 128 raw entries before deduplication, 1024 raw/normalized ASCII bytes per component and 131072 raw setting/complete output bytes. Only an explicit empty string is OK empty; null, absent Context/resolver, denied/JNI/malformed/over-limit reads are error with no partial list or stale cache. Current-user/vendor visibility limits apply; enabled access is not notification interception or malware proof. Off Android/below API31 unsupported.

Snapshot of adapter state: never_started, active, deactivated, error, or unsupported. Registration/JNI/teardown failure is explicit error state, never a clean verdict. Active does not prove uninterrupted callback ownership; no adapter or no touches cannot establish overlay absence.

Interval loss_detected when records were dropped, windows/adapter coverage lost, or JNI inputs rejected. Otherwise best_effort only with an active adapter and at least one current window; unknown otherwise. Callback replacement/restoration between probes is unobservable: this is never continuous coverage or overlay-absence evidence.

Current snapshot of registered window tokens, 0 through 32. Tokens are opaque ephemeral in-process integers and are not exported. Activity pause/stop/destroy, manual detach, detected replacement and adapter teardown remove windows. Snapshot availability must accompany interval touch deltas.

Retained dispatchTouchEvent records since the previous selected drain, including normal touches and all actions, not unique gestures. Fixed 128-record FIFO also contains lifecycle records. Overflow drops newest records; counts are lower bounds with explicit dropped/lost/invalid metadata. No touches cannot establish overlay absence.

Retained received touches with public MotionEvent FLAG_WINDOW_IS_OBSCURED bit 1, which passed through an obscured area. Counts since the previous selected drain, bounded by retained touches. Legitimate overlays/system windows are context, not malware; no package attribution. OS-blocked or undelivered touches are unobserved.

Retained received touches with public MotionEvent FLAG_WINDOW_IS_PARTIALLY_OBSCURED bit 2, obscured elsewhere in the receiving window. Counts since the previous selected drain; both bits increment both flag counters. No coordinates, content, package attribution or malware verdict. Zero cannot establish absence.

Interval newest-record drops when the fixed 128-record FIFO is full. Saturates at INT64_MAX. Current window state and loss metadata still update outside the FIFO. Retained touch counters are lower bounds after drops; selection disabled does not drain and cannot imply clean coverage.

Interval detected callback ownership/collection loss and adapter/slot failures, saturating at INT64_MAX. Not a unique-window count: repeated failures can increment it. Probe checks are nominally once per second on the main thread and before received touches, with no guarantee during a stalled looper or between probes.

Interval rejected malformed, stale-session or unknown-window JNI event inputs, saturating at INT64_MAX. Native ingress accepts only a session token, opaque positive window token, finite event kind and the two obscuration bits. Rejection remains explicit unknown/lost coverage, never a successful absence observation.

Monotonic milliseconds since the previous selected atomic drain. First drain is -1 because no previous boundary exists; subsequent zero is a measured short interval. Deltas include all sessions since the boundary, while state/window counts describe the final snapshot. Start/stop never erase pending evidence.

Opt-in list-v1 exact three manager queries from retained public Application, getPackageInfo(name,0). Each record is PACKAGE visible or PACKAGE not_visible; negative is visibility-limited and does not prove nonexistence. Any non-NameNotFound exception/null/JNI failure makes whole list error. No installed-package inventory, installation/activity/root verdict, labels or versions. Narrow manifest queries only, no permission.

Opt-in own mountinfo aggregate five records: mounts=N, overlay=N, shared=N, master=N, root_rw=true/false. Bounded descriptor read <=1MiB,4096 rows,8192 bytes/row,128 fields/row; complete grammar with octal decoding and benign nsfs roots. Malformed/denied/FIFO/final symlink/changed/over-limit input is error, no partial result. Stock namespaces/containers/overlayfs are context, no root verdict; paths/source/options never exported.

Opt-in bounded <=64-byte own readlink mnt:[nonzero decimal]. Ephemeral processnamespace context only, no other-process comparison, cross-device identifier or root/kernel-worker verdict. Unavailable/malformed/truncated link is error.

Caller network access/visibility limits apply; proxy/VPN/CA presence is environmental context, never MITM verdict.
